content: Small single-user internal CRUD apps: server-rendered monolith is the repeatedly-recommended architecture (Django/Rails/Laravel/HTMX/Hotwire pattern); SPA+API adds dual auth, CORS, duplicate validation, deployment complexity that only pays off with rich-client UIs or multiple clients. Auth: classic server-side session + httpOnly secure cookie wins for single-server internal apps; JWT adds revocation problems for zero horizontal-scaling benefit. Sprinkle interactivity with HTMX/Alpine rather than a JS framework.
